items.q: In excel, how do I use Add‑ins?
items.answer:
To use Add-ins in Excel, you can use VBA to install them. For example, to install the Analysis Toolpak add-in, you would use the following VBA code:

```vb
AddIns("analysis toolpak").Installed = True
```

Ensure you spell the add-in title e
